issues.where: ch08-s10 L0819 ('the stride shortened three times, by hand')
issues.problem: This is new since round 8, which had 'step'. In the AlexNet deep dive 'stride' is a real and different term. The bible's architecture table lists 'conv1 ... stride 4' and 'max-pool 3×3, stride 2' (bible lines 876-877). That meaning is how far the stencil jumps, not the learning rate. An expert will hear the line as 'they changed the convolution stride three times', which is wrong. A teenager has heard 'step' (L0510, 'a step downhill') and never 'stride'. The OST already says 'step size ÷ 10, three times'.
issues.fix: L0819 → 'Then five or six days downhill in fog, the step size cut three times, by hand.' (+1; claims e8-ingredients, e8-architecture). This matches L0510 and the OST exactly.

strengths: Nearly every round-8 clarity fix landed cleanly. The ten-bit label argument is now spoken. 'Read Everything' finally says what was read and why next-word prediction needs no labels ('every next word is its own right answer'), and it names GPT-2 as 'a Transformer's writing half', which closes the ch10 → ch11 bridge. The fiddly-nets candle now names the fear of stalling in the fog. L1024 is scoped to English-German. 'Deep' is glossed as 'many layers tall' before 'deep learning' is coined. The auction now ends with a buyer. 'Forecast slip' is replaced. 'Nearly right' says which condition failed. Ch12 has 'Through ChatGPT's door'. Widrow's machines 'learned by sliding downhill, toward less wrong', which pre-plants the landscape for L0510, L0607 and L0819.

The AlexNet dive is correct at expert level and still followable at fifteen. Pixels are numbers. A worked 3×3 stencil sums to 3.88 (I checked it). The OST honestly states that the real first-layer stencils are 11×11×3, so the toy is not passed off as the real thing. The stencil is slid everywhere and named as convolution. The feature-map sizes 55·27·13·13·13 → 4096·4096·1000 are right. Stencils begin as television snow and are cut by the 1986 messenger. ReLU appears as a weir, with the six-fold CIFAR-10 test. Crops and mirrors are ×2048. Dropout at p = 0.5 in fc6/fc7 only. The unprompted colour/edge split comes with the paper's own wording. Top-5 is introduced before 15.3 vs 26.2, followed by fair credit (seven nets voting, one alone 18.2%, IDSIA's earlier wins) and the one-year flip to all top-five teams.

The Transformer dive is the best teaching in the film, and every number checks. The 2014 bottleneck motivates attention. Q/K/V become question, label and message cards tuned by 'our messenger'. The dot product is 'the stencil's way'. Toy scores 2·0·4·2, halved, pour through softmax to give river 0.534 ('about half'). √dₖ is explained by its failure mode (the jug tips everything into one cup, and learning freezes), with 64 → 8 mirrored by the toy's 4 → 2. Then come eight heads, sinusoidal clock faces, 'talk, then think alone, six times over', the parallelism payoff tied to GPUs, the n² catch, and the decoder-only curtain. The ch10-s13b OST ('not the first attention · not only attention · built to translate') is exactly the hedge an expert wants.

The brief's 'what people believed, who dissented, and for how long' is spoken aloud for every era, and every span checks against the bible. Logic machine (Gerard, 16 years). Learning machine (Minsky, about 7). Sterile extension (Hinton at the rim, 17). Knowledge by hand (AAAI-84 insiders, about 7; Lenat 39). Fiddly nets (three holdouts, 10 to 15). Warm-up (IDSIA, honestly 'nobody knows exactly when'). Hand-cut stencils (Sutskever, 13). Read in order (Uszkoreit, 20). The creed (adversarial examples and Gender Shades). Scale (the octopus and the parrots). Worry (three camps). Chokepoint and gap (about two years, and a match that burned a day). The candle of now (METR's trial, with its own 'out of date' caveat).

The metaphors are built once and reused rather than replaced. Switch → knob = weight → lanterns → messenger → fog and bowl → stencil → jug → judge → curtain, with 'weights open to all' at L1408b cashing in the 1958 knob, and the reasoning-model gloss ('trained by reward, they wrote long working notes'). Contested matters stay attributed and even-handed: backprop priority with Hinton's own disclaimer, Gebru ('the accounts differ'), the physics-Nobel question, DeepSeek's cost caveat, the spread of gap estimates on screen, and Anthropic's Pentagon dispute and copyright settlement placed beside OpenAI's warning shot. The Lenat quote at L1104 checks verbatim against quotes.json.
